Tests EmbeddingModelType::Plugin variant deserialization in ChunkingConfig — config accepts the plugin variant shape; actual dispatch requires a host-language backend registered via register_embedding_backend at runtime

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ChunkingConfig, EmbeddingConfig, ExtractInputKind
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"chunking\":{\"embedding\":{\"max_embed_duration_secs\":30,\"model\":{\"name\":\"test-plugin-backend\",\"type\":\"plugin\"},\"normalize\":true},\"max_characters\":500,\"overlap\":50}}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
